actual_external_inputs.statement: Theorem 1.11: fourfold transversality at one point for a transitive Anosov with equal stable and unstable dimensions produces a free subgroup generated by an iterate and its conjugate.
actual_external_inputs.application: notes/80: solvable actual action cannot have this transversality.
scope_exclusions: Theorem 1.10 and Proposition 3.2 are dimension two only.
Theorem 1.12 gives only a free semigroup, which does not contradict solvability.

new_main_result: Full central cocycle and the coefficient pairing N_1=I, N_i=-J imply an L2 coboundary with a uniform spectral estimate. The hyperbolic normalizer then forces the slow-base displacement to vanish identically, so the actual monodromy preserves each specified topological central fibre.
corrected_countertest_scope: The square-root unitary cocycle of note81 satisfies projected equations but cannot extend to the full central equations. It is not a remaining countertest against actual slow-base drift elimination.
